description: This file contains utility functions for checking alias annotations in TorchScript graphs, including deep copying and equality checks for IValues, alias analysis, and validation of alias annotations for specific operations.

classes.name: AliasAndIValue
classes.description: A structure holding alias information and an associated IValue for alias analysis.

methods.name: deepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of an IValue, handling tensors, lists, and primitive types.

methods.name: deepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a stack of IValues.

methods.name: deepEquals
methods.description: Checks deep equality between two IValues, including tensor and tensor list comparisons.

methods.name: checkInputPreconditions
methods.description: Ensures that input IValues do not alias each other before operation execution.

methods.name: checkAliases
methods.description: Verifies that aliasing relationships between inputs and outputs are correctly annotated.

methods.name: checkWrites
methods.description: Ensures that inputs not marked as writeable have not been modified after operation.

methods.name: findNodeForOp
methods.description: Finds the node in a graph corresponding to a given operation name, considering aliasing and operator types.

methods.name: toIValueProp
methods.description: Attempts to evaluate a Value to an IValue, handling list constructs and constant folding.

methods.name: shouldIgnoreNode
methods.description: Determines if a node should be ignored during alias checking, e.g., batch_norm and instance_norm.

methods.name: checkAliasAnnotation
methods.description: Main function to check alias annotations for a specific operation in a TorchScript graph, validating aliasing and modifications.
